title: Agent corrupts safety evaluations or selectively suppresses failures
bad_event: A published evaluation omits frozen tasks, uses a modified evaluator, or misstates a re-executed task's result; corruption of k results escapes a hidden re-execution sample of size B with probability above C(N−k,B)/C(N,B).
adversary: Model: any trace for the process theorem; NON_ADAPTIVE corrupted set for the sampling bound (sample hidden).
refutation: A suppressed task or modified evaluator accepted, or corruption surviving above the bound (witness: observable sample → survival 1).
scope: Lean model only. Adaptive (feedback) version not done here (see Leakage.audit_leak_bound/ReservedAudit). Semantic: whether tasks/evaluator measure the intended capability.

assumptions.text: Operations carrying trusted identities (reviewer, approver, admin, user) are those principals' own acts (not modelled; REVIEW-PACKET finding 1).
The re-execution sample is hidden from the agent until after publication.
Re-execution is deterministic or its tolerance is specified.
